_doc: QUY TAC SONG SONG (docs/crm-kb/08-extension-parity.md): action GAS dung o CA Zalo AI va Pancake AI thi khong can ghi o day. Action chi o MOT ben PHAI co dong o day: 'platform' = dac thu nen tang (co ly do), 'gap' = ben kia CHUA co, can Duyen chot co lam khong. tools/check-ext-parity.js bao LOI khi co action lech ma chua ghi o day. LUU Y: script chi thay lech o muc ACTION GAS; lech trong NOI DUNG phan hoi (vd Pancake AI hien anh san pham kem goi y tra loi) khong bi bat — theo doi bang tay o docs/crm-kb/08-extension-parity.md muc 'Lech khong do duoc bang script'.
